findings.issue: A category with no eligible events makes semantic_search raise the missing-vector error even when this model already has cached vectors. Both semantic Search and Ask fail instead of returning empty results; preserve the missing-model error while allowing a filtered no-match result.

summary: Fixed one medium-severity defect: semantic category filters with no matches now return empty Search results and Ask evidence instead of incorrectly requesting --embed. Regression tests fail before the one-line fix and pass afterward; all 24 relevant tests and 94 independent widget controls pass. The full offline runner still fails with two Windows WinError 87 process-launch errors, both reproduced using the original head under the same subprocess invocation.
